entities.summary: Malisheva or Mališevo is a town and municipality in Kosovo. The municipality is part of the District of Prizren and it is located in the central part of Kosovo. Malisheva has a population of 43,888 inhabitants. Malisheva is a human settlement. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
